interactionSteps.note: Text becomes 4 sessions available in the next seven days.

title: Busy state is set and never cleared
description: The availability check marks its status region aria-busy=true before the update and never removes the attribute. The visible results are correct, but assistive technology may keep treating the region as still updating and withhold the new content.

relatedElements.note: Clears aria-busy after rendering the results.

expectedBehaviour: A busy state is cleared once the update is complete, so the new content can be announced.
actualBehaviour: aria-busy=true remains on the status region after the results have rendered.
userImpact: Screen-reader users may never hear the result count even though it is visible on screen.

wcag.note: A status update may be withheld because the region is marked busy indefinitely.

observed.note: Page-level axe run with tags wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa and best-practice. No violation was reported for this page in its default state; the control on the same page also passes.

detection.note: The attribute is only observable after the asynchronous update.

manualTests: Activate Check availability with a screen reader running and listen for the result count.

assistiveTechnologyTests.procedure: Navigate to the target with the VoiceOver rotor and confirm what is announced.

assertions: aria-busy remains true after the results text is rendered.
tests: tests/subtle-defects.spec.js: keeps the busy state set in variant A

reviewStatus.note: A Playwright regression test preserves the defective behaviour and its control. That is automated reproduction, not a manual or assistive-technology observation.
